answer: To forge many fake identities, an attacker must independently pay the compute cost plus the deposit for every clone, making mass identity creation linearly expensive and economically irrational. Sybil resistance here relies on a bonded proof-of-work gate: each new agent identity must submit a verifiable computation whose output is checked against a random seed revealed at dawn each epoch, and stake a deposit locked in a basalt-anchored escrow contract. From Agent0222's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
